steps.action: Launch a new grain through the app's "New Welcome Pearl" action and open it as the grain owner.
steps.expectedResult: The grain serves a page titled "Awaiting configuration" whose heading reads "This account-opening service" and whose body reads "This account-opening service is not configured yet — the operator must connect it to its DueProcess template before applications can be accepted.", followed by a grey line naming the DueProcess template hydration call this release awaits. This is the correct fresh-grain state, served with a normal success status: no 403, no blank page, no reset, no process failure.

steps.action: Read the whole first screen and look for any way to start an application.
steps.expectedResult: There is none, and that is the pass condition. The page carries no account-type choice, no country picker, no currency picker, no submit control, and no link or button of any kind. A fresh grain has never had an intake dataset hydrated from its DueProcess template, so this release fails closed to the notice instead of rendering a partly-hydrated or locally-defaulted questionnaire. A probe run that reaches a pre-qualifier questionnaire on a fresh grain is a FAILURE: it means a baked default profile was persisted.

steps.action: Reload the grain from the shell.
steps.expectedResult: The same "Awaiting configuration" notice renders again. The unconfigured state is read from the grain's own persisted config (an empty tenant profile with no template-hydration timestamp), not a first-paint race that would settle into a form.

steps.action: Open the operator surface by entering the grain-relative path "admin" as the grain owner. This step needs a typed path on purpose: the fail-closed landing deliberately exposes no navigation, so no click path to the operator surface exists on a fresh grain.
steps.expectedResult: The operator inbox renders with every tenant profile field blank and the client-onboarding section reporting "AdminGate not connected — autospawn will fail closed", with an unchecked autospawn setting. The page must not claim any binding is in place. A session without the administrator role gets "Admin access required." instead.

launchProbe.expectedResult: A fresh Welcome pearl grain launches, serves its intake front door, and correctly refuses to accept applications until an operator connects it to a DueProcess template — while its operator surface renders and honestly reports itself unconnected.

fixtures.name: Fresh Welcome pearl grain
fixtures.purpose: Prove the packaged app launches and that its account-opening front door is fail-closed, rather than serving a hardcoded default tenant questionnaire, before any operator configuration exists.
fixtures.setup: Install this version, create a new grain, and open it as its owner. Do not connect an AdminGate capability, do not run a template refresh, and do not write /var/melusina/welcome.env. No sidecar, no Powerbox grant and no outbound network access is required for this probe.

steps: Delete the temporary acceptance-test grain after the visible launch probe completes.
No external state is created: this probe writes only the grain's own /var (an empty config row and its per-grain callback secret), makes no outbound network call, and reaches no sidecar.
